title: Data Engineer, VP
description:
Closing date for applications: 16/09/2026



Location Chennai, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00283898

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a Data Engineer


* You’ll be the voice of our customers, using data to tell their stories and put them at the heart of all decision\-making
* We’ll look to you to drive the build of effortless, digital first customer experiences
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far\-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a Data Engineer, you’ll be looking to simplify our organisation by developing innovative data driven solutions through data pipelines, modelling and ETL design, inspiring to be commercially successful while keeping our customers, and the bank’s data, safe and secure.


You’ll drive customer value by understanding complex business problems and requirements to correctly apply the most appropriate and reusable tool to gather and build data solutions. You’ll support our strategic direction by engaging with the data engineering community to deliver opportunities, along with carrying out complex data engineering tasks to build a scalable data architecture.


Your responsibilities will also include:


* Building advanced automation of data engineering pipelines through removal of manual stages
* Embedding new data techniques into our business through role modelling, training, and experiment design oversight
* Delivering a clear understanding of data platform costs to meet your departments cost saving and income targets
* Sourcing new data using the most appropriate tooling for the situation
* Developing solutions for streaming data ingestion and transformations in line with our streaming strategy

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------


To thrive in this role, you’ll need a strong understanding of data usage and dependencies and experience of extracting value and features from large scale data. You’ll also bring practical experience of programming languages alongside knowledge of data and software engineering fundamentals.


Additionally, you’ll need:


* Expertise in designing and building AI agent architectures, including planning loops, tool integration, memory management, multi\-turn conversations, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, grounding, and output validation
* Strong experience in developing MCP servers/clients, APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, queues, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems and data platforms
* Proficiency in cloud\-native infrastructure, deployment, scaling, IAM, secrets management, networking, observability, cost optimisation, and operating production\-grade AI applications securely and reliably
* Ability to build evaluation frameworks, automated testing and regression controls, implement guardrails and compliance measures, ensure auditability and model governance, and provide technical leadership to drive engineering excellence
* Strong communication skills with the ability to proactively engage and manage a wide range of stakeholders

**Welcome to our Chennai hub**
------------------------------


Nestled in the heart of One India Bulls Park, our hub in Kosmo One, Tower A, is one of Ambattur’s first skyscraper spanning 420,000 sq. ft.


### **Key facts:**


* Surrounded by 10 acres
* Space for 3,600 colleagues
* Opened in 2009

description:

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

title: Data Engineer, MIDAS, Digital Acceleration
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you excited about the digital media revolution and passionate about designing and delivering advanced analytics that directly influence the product decisions of Amazon's digital businesses. Do you see yourself as a champion of innovating on behalf of the customer by turning data insights into action?  

  

The Amazon Digital Acceleration (DA) org is looking for an analytical and technically skilled data engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a critical part in developing foundational analytical datasets spanning orders, subscriptions, discovery, promotions, pricing and royalties. Our mission is to enable digital clients to easily innovate with data on behalf of customers and make product and customer decisions faster.
  

  

An ideal individual is someone who has deep data engineering skills around ETL, data modeling, database architecture and big data solutions. This individual should have strong business judgement, excellent written and verbal communication skills.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Develop data products, infrastructure and data pipelines leveraging AWS services (such as Redshift, Kinesis, EMR, Lambda etc.) and internal BDT tools (Datanet, Cradle, QuickSight etc.  

  

2\. Improve existing solutions/build solutions to improve scale, quality, IMR efficiency, data availability, consistency \& compliance.  

  

3\. Partner with Software Developers, Business Intelligence Engineers, MLEs, Scientists, and Product Managers to develop scalable and maintainable data pipelines on both structured and unstructured (text based) data.  

  

4\. Drive operational excellence strongly within the team and build automation and mechanisms to reduce operations  

  

About the team  

The MIDAS team operates within Amazon's Digital Analytics (DA) engineering organization, building analytics and data engineering solutions that support cross\-digital teams. Our platform delivers a wide range of capabilities, including metadata discovery, data lineage, customer segmentation, compliance automation, AI\-driven data access through generative AI and LLMs, and advanced data quality monitoring. Today, more than 100 Amazon business and technology teams rely on MIDAS, with over 20,000 monthly active users leveraging our mission\-critical tools to drive data\-driven decisions at Amazon scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with SQL
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala)
* Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR
* Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast. **Job Summary**


The ServiceNow Developer E4 is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform, supporting Sky Deutschland's digital transformation and service management objectives. The role combines deep technical expertise with strong collaboration skills to deliver innovative, reliable, and efficient platform capabilities across multiple business domains. A key focus of this position is supporting the migration and consolidation of ServiceNow environments, ensuring the successful transition of applications, integrations, workflows, and data while minimizing business disruption. The role contributes to platform standardization, technical governance, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping drive operational excellence and long\-term platform sustainability. Working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Infrastructure teams, Security teams, and external partners, the ServiceNow Developer E4 will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, promote development best practices, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and service management standards.**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform, including custom applications, workflows, automations, and integrations.
* Configure and enhance core ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, and related platform modules.
* Develop and support integrations with internal and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, and other ServiceNow integration capabilities.
* Support the ongoing maintenance and evolution of the ServiceNow platform, including version upgrades, architectural improvements, platform performance, and technical governance.
* Play a key role in ServiceNow platform migration and consolidation initiatives, supporting application assessment, solution redesign, configuration migration, and data transition activities.
* Ensure solution quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and adherence to ServiceNow development best practices and governance standards.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Infrastructure, Security, and vendor teams to deliver business\-driven platform enhancements.
* Contribute to Agile delivery, continuous improvement initiatives, and the long\-term roadmap of the ServiceNow platform.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* 7 to 10 years of proven experience delivering solutions across core ServiceNow capabilities, including ITSM, Service Catalogue, CMDB, Knowledge Management, Flow Designer, and Integration Hub.
* Experience supporting the full ServiceNow platform lifecycle, including version upgrades, architectural evolution, performance optimization, and technical governance.
* Experience contributing to ServiceNow migration, consolidation, or transformation initiatives, including the assessment of customizations, integrations, and data migration requirements. Exposure to mergers, acquisitions, or large\-scale platform integration programs would be beneficial.
* Experience with Discovery, Service Mapping, or other platform capabilities would be preferrable.
* Strong development skills in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting frameworks, with the ability to design scalable, maintainable, and high\-performing solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and connecting ServiceNow with enterprise applications and services.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders in Agile delivery environments complete your profile.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA are highly valued, while CAD, CIS, or other advanced ServiceNow certifications are considered preferrable.

As a Modernization Engineer, a typical day involves designing and validating innovative hosting environments that are both agile and cost\-efficient. The role focuses on creating scalable and high\-performance hosting infrastructures tailored to support contemporary corporate and digital applications. This position also entails transforming and migrating legacy systems to modern platforms, ensuring seamless integration and enhanced business capabilities. Collaboration with various stakeholders to align infrastructure solutions with evolving business needs is a key aspect of the daily workflow, fostering continuous improvement and operational excellence.  

  

Role Summary  

Highly experienced Azure Cloud Architect responsible for designing, implementing, and managing enterprise\-scale Azure environments across multiple regions and subscriptions. The role focuses on Azure Landing Zones, cloud networking, security, identity management, automation, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.  

Key Responsibilities  

Design and implement enterprise\-scale Azure Landing Zones and cloud governance frameworks.  

Architect secure and scalable Azure networking solutions, including multi\-region connectivity, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Private Endpoints, and hybrid connectivity.  

Lead Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) deployments and modernization initiatives.  

Implement Azure security and identity solutions using Entra ID, PIM, Identity Governance, Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, and Sentinel.  

Develop automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Azure DevOps, Bicep, PowerShell, and CI/CD pipelines.  

Design and manage monitoring, logging, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.  

Implement Azure Integration Services including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Event Hub, and Data Factory.  

Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives through governance, reservations, and resource utilization improvements.  

Provide technical leadership, architectural governance, and best\-practice guidance for cloud transformation programs.
